frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: I think we've cleared a path.

frames.heading: Moxie
frames.body: Thank you for freeing our planet, I wish you the best of luck!

frames.heading: Ozzy
frames.body: I feel so much better now that the space junk has been destroyed!

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Thank you, friends. Soon, the Grand Composer will be silenced...
